query: SELECT GREATEST( COALESCE( min(CASE WHEN work.delivery_state = 'pending' THEN work.retry_not_before WHEN work.delivery_state = 'claimed' THEN work.claim_expires_at END), clock_timestamp() + interval '100 milliseconds'), clock_timestamp() + interval '100 milliseconds') AS "next_ready_at!", clock_timestamp() AS "database_now!" FROM central.recovery_epoch_workspaces AS work JOIN central.recovery_epochs AS epoch ON epoch.epoch_generation = work.epoch_generation AND epoch.coordinator_domain = $2 WHERE work.epoch_generation = $1 AND work.delivery_state IN ('pending', 'claimed')
